Priya: Heads-up — before tomorrow's load run I want agreement on a minimal metric glossary + a small sanity probe for kernel selection, batching heuristics, and KV cache behavior. Key ask: TTFT vs TPOT, goodput vs QPS, p95/p99 semantics, and an apples-to-apples probe matrix. Can folks +1 and call out anything missing?

Matt: +1. Two quick notes: 1) kernel selection bias — we must use identical input seq distribution when we compare kernels; 2) harness should allow forcing kernel flags so we can A/B.

Zhen: Agreed. Proposed glossary (short):
- TTFT = time from request arrival to first non-empty token emitted to client (stream start).
- TPOT = time from arrival to final token emitted (stream end / completion).
- p95/p99 are computed on per-request TTFT/TPOT across successful requests (exclude retries).
- Goodput = tokens successfully processed / second (useful tokens), QPS = request starts / second.
I'll post a quick doc link after this thread.

bench-bot: automated note: baseline micro-run (1705123000) finished on build-rt-5. Observations: kernel switch happens for seq > 512; kvcache warm reduced median TTFT by ~18%.

Oliver: Profiling note: kernel_dispatch hotspot at higher sequence lengths — ~60ms spent in dispatch+setup when quantized kernel selected. Suggestion: cache kernel choice at model+seq_hash for ~1s to avoid repeated lookup cost.

Priya: For batching heuristics we should constrain batch size growth after X ms to avoid TPOT tail blowups. Probe should vary batch_timeout and max_batch to measure tradeoffs.

Matt: On KV cache: replay harness must preserve session affinity so kvcache hit-rates reflect real traffic. Synthetic runs must simulate prefix overlap ratio; otherwise kvcache metrics are meaningless.

Zhen: Proposed probe matrix (min set):
- batch_timeout_ms: [8, 16, 32]
- max_batch: [8, 32, 128]
- seq_profile: [short(<=64), mixed, long(>1024)]
- prefix_overlap: [0.1, 0.5, 0.9]
Run 3 seeds each, capture TTFT/TPOT p50/p95/p99, QPS, goodput, batch composition histograms.

Priya: +1. Add apples-to-apples constraints: same random seed for input ordering, identical tokenization artifacting, same kernel-forcing flags when comparing kernels, identical pre-warm schedule (N requests per model).

bench-bot: quick experiment posted: forced kernel B vs default baseline for seq>1024: delta p95 TTFT = +24%. Raw snippet: ```kernel=default: p95_TTFT=210ms
kernel=forced_B: p95_TTFT=260ms```

Oliver: That tail increase matches when batches coalesce heterogeneous lengths. We should instrument per-batch seq-length histogram and per-batch kernel choices (sample 1/10 batches if perf cost too high).

Matt: Regression hypothesis: PR #3412 (batch allocator change) may increase tails by creating larger heterogeneous batches. Repro path: run replay with seq-mix ratio=0.6 and compare p95 with and without PR.

Priya: Action items: 1) Zhen to run full probe matrix tomorrow AM and post aggregated CSVs; 2) Oliver to add per-batch histogram instrumentation (sampled); 3) Matt to prototype 1s kernel-choice cache and measure delta; 4) bench-bot to produce per-run summary with TTFT/TPOT p50/p95/p99 + goodput/QPS and attach logs. I'll coordinate and collect the artifacts.

Zhen: Noted, starting warmups now. ETA ~2.5h for first pass.

bench-bot: scheduled runs queued. Will post run summaries when done :robot_face:
